# Definitive Edition Sample

Introductory material for tests.

## Spells

Hermetic spells follow Technique and Form pairs.

### LEVEL 20

#### Pilum of Fire

R: Voice, D: Momentary, T: Individual

A javelin of fire flies from your hand and strikes a single target, doing +15 damage.
Creo Ignem effect.

## Virtues

#### Second Sight
*Minor, Supernatural*

You can see invisible things and spirits that are present.

#### Affinity with Ignem
*Minor, Hermetic*

You learn Ignem more quickly.

## Flaws

#### Necessary Condition
*Major, Hermetic*

You can only cast spells under a specific condition.

#### Magical Air

Minor Personality Flaw

People sense something uncanny about you.

## Universities

### New Virtues and Flaws

University social status writeups use category-first italics.

#### New Virtues

**Baccalaureus**<br>
*Social Status, Minor*

The character has completed a three-year university program.

#### Doctor in (Faculty)

*Social Status, Major*

The character has graduated from a higher faculty.

**Jurist**<br>
*Social Status, Minor*

The character is a medieval lawyer.

**Nuntius**<br>
*Social Status, Free*

The character delivers messages for a university nation.

**Prestigious Student**<br>
*General, Minor*

The character is a wealthy university student.

#### New Flaws

**Failed Student**<br>
*Story, Minor*

The character failed a university examination.

**Poor Disputer**<br>
*General, Minor*

The character suffers a penalty on disputatio rolls.

## Spell Guidelines

### Creo Ignem Guidelines

Spells that create fires are versatile weapons.

| Level | Creo Ignem Guideline |
| ----- | -------------------- |
| 1 | • Create light equivalent to moonlight |
| 2 | • Create light equivalent to candlelight<br>• Heat an object to be warm to the touch |
| 5 | • Create a fire doing +10 damage |

## Abilities

#### Awareness

*Specialties:* bodyguarding, keeping watch, alertness, searching. (General)

Noticing things that you are not actively searching for.

#### Ceremony\*

*Specialties:* with a certain Power or Ability, in particular circumstances. (Supernatural)

Used with other Infernal Abilities to produce a greater effect.
